name: co.appscreen/mcp
title: AppScreen
description: Render App Store and Google Play screenshots from app captures: device frames, sizes, languages.

environmentVariables.name: APPSCREEN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional MCP key (mcm_live_…) from https://appscreen.co/account/keys. Omit for 5 free anonymous renders.

environmentVariables.name: APPSCREEN_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.appscreen.co.
